general_direction: Difference and uniqueness were what mattered about Cairnfold, not folds or a particular anatomy. Preserve unusual body plans and exaggerated faces; reduce facial exaggeration only a touch. Strong painted fantasy character, fewer repeated folds, and less stereotypical science-fiction alien appearance.
